name: report

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

rootId.description: Only this depth-0 root (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix). Default: all. [select: usage, gates, notes, contention, waste]

since.description: Window start, inclusive, ISO 8601. Default/cap: describe.

groupBy.description: Grouping; subset/default per select. [select: usage, gates, notes, contention]

limit.description: Page size 1-200 (default 50) [select: usage, gates, notes, contention]

cursor.description: page.next of the prior page [select: usage, gates, notes, contention]

anchorId.description: Subtree incl. itself (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix). [select: notes, rollup]

runId.description: Roll up this run (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix) [select: rollup]

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

seatToken.description: Run seat token; omit when not seated.

description: Aggregate metrics to see how work is going and where it stalls. select: usage (call metrics), gates (rejections), notes (writes), contention (claims, leases), waste, rollup (subtree or run). Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
